nodes.description: SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256) internal pure; asserts c >= a and returns the checked sum used for all credit operations.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) internal pure; asserts b <= a and returns the checked difference used for all debit operations.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256) internal pure; overflow-checked multiplication helper.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) internal pure; division helper that reverts on division by zero.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) public onlyOwner; rewrites the owner state variable after a zero-address check.
Pausable.pause() public onlyOwner whenNotPaused; sets paused = true and emits Pause.
Pausable.unpause() public onlyOwner whenPaused; sets paused = false and emits Unpause.
StandardToken.transfer(address,uint256) public; blacklist check on msg.sender, zero-address check, debits sender and credits recipient via SafeMath.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public; blacklist check, balance and allowance checks, then SafeMath debit of balance and allowance.
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256) public; overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with _value (classic approve race pattern).
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address,uint256) public; SafeMath.add on the existing allowance slot.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address,uint256) public; clamps to zero or SafeMath.sub on the existing allowance slot.
StandardToken._blackList(address,bool) internal; flips the tokenBlacklist flag with a state-changed requirement.
StandardToken.balanceOf(address) public view; reads the balances mapping.
StandardToken.allowance(address,address) public view; reads the allowed nested mapping.
PausableToken.transfer(address,uint256) public whenNotPaused; delegates to StandardToken.transfer via super.
PausableToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public whenNotPaused; delegates to StandardToken.transferFrom via super.
PausableToken.approve(address,uint256) public whenNotPaused; delegates to StandardToken.approve via super.
PausableToken.increaseApproval(address,uint256) public whenNotPaused; delegates to the base implementation.
PausableToken.decreaseApproval(address,uint256) public whenNotPaused; delegates to the base implementation.
PausableToken.blackListAddress(address,bool) public whenNotPaused onlyOwner; privileged wrapper around StandardToken._blackList.
ComfortNFT constructor; mints 100000000 * 10**decimals to msg.sender, sets owner and emits Transfer from address(0).
ComfortNFT.burn(uint256) public; burns tokens from msg.sender by calling internal _burn.
ComfortNFT._burn(address,uint256) internal; SafeMath.sub on balance and totalSupply then emits Burn/Transfer.
ComfortNFT.mint(address,uint256) public onlyOwner; SafeMath.add on totalSupply and credited balance.
address public owner declared in Ownable; privilege anchor for every onlyOwner modifier.
bool public paused = false declared in Pausable; gate for whenNotPaused/whenPaused.
uint256 public totalSupply declared in ERC20Basic; mutated by constructor, mint and _burn.
mapping(address => uint256) balances declared in StandardToken; holder ledger.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed declared in StandardToken; spender allowance ledger.
mapping(address => bool) tokenBlacklist declared in StandardToken; only enforced against msg.sender in transfer/transferFrom.
string public name = "ComfortNFT".
string public symbol = "COMF".
uint256 public decimals = 18; used to scale the initial supply.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balance debits, blacklist checks, allowance ownership and every ownership comparison.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) inside StandardToken.transfer; state-mutating arithmetic on caller balance.
balances[_to].add(_value) inside StandardToken.transfer; state-mutating arithmetic on recipient balance.
balances[_from].sub(_value) inside StandardToken.transferFrom; debits a third-party balance.
balances[_to].add(_value) inside StandardToken.transferFrom; credits the destination balance.
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) inside StandardToken.transferFrom; consumes spender allowance.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value inside StandardToken.approve; unconditional allowance overwrite (approve race condition pattern).
SafeMath.add applied to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] inside increaseApproval.
Branching allowance reduction (set 0 or SafeMath.sub) inside decreaseApproval.
totalSupply = totalSupply.add(amount) inside ComfortNFT.mint; owner-gated supply inflation.
totalSupply = totalSupply.sub(_value) inside _burn; supply deflation.
100000000 * 10**decimals initial supply computation written into totalSupply in the constructor (unchecked plain arithmetic).
